MpvFlux needs access to your video files to provide its core functionality as a media player.
The permission is used exclusively for:
• Discovering and displaying your video files\n• Playing media content\n• Loading subtitle files
MpvFlux requires storage access because it\'s essential for finding all media and subtitle files on your device, including ones the system doesn\'t index.
Due to a change in security policy, apps built for Android 11 and above need this additional permission to access the same files.
This permission is only used to discover media and subtitle files on your device. It does not give access to the private data of other apps.
MpvFlux is open source. You can review the code and verify how permissions are used in our GitHub repository:
Your files are never used for anything else, uploaded or stored on any server. They stay on your device.
